summary.intent: Coordinate a multi-agent workflow on the callisto repo: align the CLI spec's documented exit codes with the binary's real behavior, open a PR for it, and launch a second wave of refactors (changed.rs rewrite, error-code scanner collapse).
summary.outcome: Opened PR #512 aligning docs/specs/cli.json exit codes with the binary and fixing the `snapshot --tag` help text. Wave 2 refactors (changed.rs without pathspecs, one error-code scan) were launched and are still running; two design decisions await the user.

repo: docs/stability.md defines exit code 2 as bad or missing argument or flag, including values validated after parsing; docs/specs/cli.json had drifted from it by documenting exit 1.
Exit codes are inconsistent for bad flag values: unknown `--package` exits 1 (E102) while E227 exits 2. CLI-INIT-12 splits by outcome: E195, E196, E298 exit 2; E187, E188, E189 exit 1.
`snapshot --tag` accepts only letters, digits and `-` (`feature/x` fails with E324), so the old help text 'commit SHA or branch name' was wrong.
The JSON error envelope already emits a `dryRun` key that the spec did not document.
The PR template has Summary, Type of change, Changeset, Docs and Test Plan sections; doc-only changes can opt out of a changeset.
Repo checks are pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and workflow-contracts; `just ci` is the full suite.
Commits on the branch are signed (-S); signature verification on GitHub was not checked.

code.finding: Modified as part of the error-code scanner collapse, which merges overlapping scanner tests into one that discovers source files itself, with no hand-kept file list.

workflow: Verify the docs branch merges cleanly into the updated main with `git merge-tree --write-tree` before opening a PR.
Wave-based delegation: run independent refactors in isolated worktrees in parallel, and have a subagent draft PR text that the coordinator then files.
Subagent hand-backs are treated as reports, not user approval; the PR was opened from drafted text only after review of the diff.
Before deleting old tests in the scanner collapse, require the new test to fail on a duplicate code, a code removed from the docs, and a variant without a code.

friction: CI had not run on the docs branch, so the PR relies on locally run checks.
GitHub signature verification was not checked on the pushed commit.
Progress is gated on two unresolved user decisions about exit-code policy.
open_items: Decide whether bad flag values should uniformly exit 2 (unknown `--package` currently exits 1 with E102).
Decide whether `pre-major-inference = "false"` should be documented as an alias or removed.
Wait for the changed.rs rewrite and error-code scanner collapse agents to finish, then review them.
Refresh release PR #493 (0.20.0) so the rendered changelog can be reviewed.
Write the Brain memory for the invariant ladder.
Clean up leftover `worktree-agent-*` branches once the user's review is done.
